title: Hydraulic, Thermal, Chemical, and Equipment Constraints for ETP & ZLD System Safety

data.Constraint Description: Biological Aeration Basin Thermal & Operational Envelope
data.Chemical Limits: Free Chlorine = 0.0 mg/L; Heavy metals < 1.0 mg/L
data.Hydraulic Constraints: Min HRT 18 Hours; Max Surface Overflow Rate 1.0 m³/m²/hr in clarifier
data.Biological Constraints: DO maintained strictly between 2.0 and 3.0 mg/L; MLSS 3,500 - 4,500 mg/L
data.Equipment Constraints: Blower VFD minimum frequency 30 Hz to prevent motor overheating
data.Seasonal Constraints: Summer: Activate cooling tower if feed temp > 40°C; Winter: Maintain bio-temp > 22°C

data.Chemical Limits: Free Chlorine = 0.0 mg/L (ORP < 200 mV); Oil & Grease = 0.0 mg/L
data.Loading Limits: Feed SDI15 < 3.0; Max Feed Turbidity < 0.5 NTU
data.Hydraulic Constraints: Stage 1 Max Recovery 75%; High Pressure Stage 2 Max Recovery 70% (Total 93%)
data.Biological Constraints: Zero bio-film leak from UF; Log bio-count < 10 CFU/mL
data.Equipment Constraints: Max Operating Pressure: Stage 1 = 25 bar, Stage 2 = 65 bar
data.Seasonal Constraints: Hot weather increases membrane flux; adjust antiscalant dosage to prevent silica scaling.

data.Constraint Description: Multiple Effect Evaporator (MEE) Thermal & COD Envelope
data.Chemical Limits: Feed COD < 300 mg/L (High COD causes severe boiling foam & condensate contamination)
data.Loading Limits: Max Feed TDS 100,000 mg/L; Discharge Slurry TDS 350,000 mg/L
data.Hydraulic Constraints: Falling film recirculation velocity > 1.8 m/s to prevent tube fouling
data.Biological Constraints: Zero live biological culture allowed in evaporator feed
data.Equipment Constraints: Steam Supply Pressure 2.5 - 4.0 bar; Vacuum in last effect 650-680 mmHg
data.Seasonal Constraints: High ambient humidity reduces cooling tower vacuum efficiency; lower steam rate.
